key_v2_as_printed_note: v2 key (printed on the H2D 2026-11-19): arm tops at z=-7.75, 0.45 mm (horizontal) below the 45-degree chamfer. FEA has no contact; with the arm tip moving 1.07 mm inward the arm top would overlap the chamfer by ~0.6 mm, so those arms jam after 0.45 mm of travel and must twist to pass a 10.0 mm slot. Fixed in v2_1 (arm_top -8.9).
